title: Find Kth Largest XOR Coordinate Value
summary: Given a m x n matrix with non-negative integers, find the k^th largest XOR value of all coordinates (a, b) where the XOR is calculated over all elements in the submatrix from (0,0) to (a,b).
statement: Given a m x n matrix with non-negative integers, find the k^th largest XOR value of all coordinates (a, b) where the XOR is calculated over all elements in the submatrix from (0,0) to (a,b).
constraints: For coordinate (r,c), XOR every matrix value in rows 0..r and columns 0..c.
Return the kth largest coordinate value, counting duplicate coordinates separately.
hints: A two-dimensional XOR prefix has the same overlap cancellation pattern as a sum prefix.
Build prefix[r][c] from the cell, upper prefix, left prefix, and diagonal prefix.
Collect every coordinate prefix, sort descending, and return index k-1.
Each prior cell appears exactly once after XOR cancellation, and sorting gives the requested coordinate rank.
editorial: Each prior cell appears exactly once after XOR cancellation, and sorting gives the requested coordinate rank.

tests.explanation: Coordinate XOR values are 5,7,4,0, so the largest is seven.
The fourth largest coordinate XOR value is zero.
